name: blockascene
description: Block4Film offline scene blocking editor for desktop and tablet
author: Block4Film

scripts.dist:win: npm run icons && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.test:model: node tests/model.test.cjs && node tests/playback.test.cjs && node tests/manual.test.cjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run icons && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.android:prepare: npx cap add android && npx cap sync android && node scripts/apply-android-icons.cjs
scripts.android:sync: npx cap sync android && node scripts/apply-android-icons.cjs
